note: Names the rules profile and the drawings of this project, so no project name sits in the Python files. Paths are relative to the repo root, except inputRoot, which is the folder of the real input files on this machine. schedules names the two past schedule workbooks that the level proof reads from the References folder under inputRoot. drawings holds one file name per role. baseplan has the plot faces and labels. masterplan is the current master plan drawing, the second source check reads it and config/second_source.json names its plot layers. previousMasterplan is the master plan it replaced, kept for reference and not read in the full run. villaBlocks is the drawing the villa block of each unit is read from. roadLayout is the road layout drawing, its road edges give the front of a row. xrefRoles maps the name of an xref file that is not on disk to the role of the drawing that stands in for it. skip lists the other drawings the full run does not read, each with its reason. referenceOnly lists the drawings kept for reference only, R06_0000 and R06_0001 saved on this machine, which no villa block reader may take, since the villa blocks come from villaBlocks, the Building Footprint (Bader, Q045, R300). The analysis block holds how the CAD analysis reads the drawings. Lengths are in metres. partyWallShare is the share of plot.long_side that a shared edge must reach to count as a party wall. endShare is how far from the centre of a row, as a share of plot.long_side, a shared edge must lie to count as the front or the back of the row. roadEdgeLayers names the layers of the road layout drawing that hold the road edge polylines. unitPlotTypes lists the client plot types of the baseplan labels that stand for a plot with a unit on it, so only those plots get an issue when no unit code is found for them (R69). It is a list of plot types and never maps a plot type to a unit code (R30). noRev6Match lists the cluster codes of the profile that are old client codes with no Rev 6 cluster, and every cluster written with one of them gets an issue (R75). blockClusters maps the name of a footprint block to the cluster code it hints at, a block that stands for 2 or 4 plots says those plots are one cluster and it never gives a unit code to a plot (R90). The unit code of a plot is its Excel unit and nothing else (R69). pairRule false keeps the mirror flags of the blocks out of the row split until the original and mirror convention is known (R70). pastJob names what python/plan_from_past.py reads to build plan.json from a past job (R81). schedule is one of schedules and sheet is its sheet. prototypes is the full path of a kept copy of the prototypes.json the Revit reader wrote on the past model, since a later reader run writes prototypes.json again. prototypeFolder is the folder of the KEO prototype files under inputRoot, the Revit 2021 files of the past job, kept as the source. upgradedPrototypeFolder is the folder of their Revit 2024 copies with the same file names (R109), the folder plan.json gives the placer. output is the full path of the plan file, outside the repo. parameters lists the shared parameters to write on each link, RRE_ZZ_SP_Prototype-FFL is never one of them. testHost names what the Revit test host of R103 runs on. model is the site model under inputRoot that each run copies to <name>_TEST-<code>.rvt next to it, by a file copy only, and order is the prototype codes in the order they are tested, one per run. imageStepMinutes is the most the image step of an image job may run (Bader, Q061, R302), Run-TestHost.ps1 writes it into the job. imageMarginMinutes is what the job may run on top of it for the open and the close of the model, several times what the NBH 03 file took, whose measures are in steps/investigations/round-addin.md (CHOSEN, Round ADDIN). The job total is the two together and the window limit 3 minutes more. pastJob.baseplanPlots is plots.json of the CAD reader run on the baseplan, relative to the repo root, and its plot faces give each yard floor its plot (R111). floors names what the floor step of the placer places (R112 to R116). types gives the floor type names of each kind, generic, yard and ramp, and the plan builder, the placer and the check use only these. levels gives the level of each kind. plotParameter is the floor parameter that holds unit-plot, for example VD2-2441, on all three kinds. yardBelowFflM is how far the top of the yard sits below the FFL (Bader, 24 Oct). yardShareTie is the share difference under which two plots tie for one yard. yardMinShare is the least share the best face must hold, under it the yard goes to no plot and is listed (round 15b review). cadLinks holds what the links from CAD are measured with (R120 to R123). cutShareMin is the share of its Generic floor that the baseplan face of a plot must hold, a plot under it does not follow the baseplan cut and is listed apart in every comparison (R120). cutNeighbours lists the plots Bader added to the cut plots, the neighbours of the listed plots whose links or ramps follow the past cut of those plots, and they are listed apart with them (R120). caseParameters names the link parameters the CASE test of R132 compares the second letter with. floorWidthStepM is the step the plot width is rounded to when the Generic and yard outlines are grouped (R135). planOutput is the full path of the plan python/plan_from_cad.py writes, outside the repo next to the plan of the past job (R128). handCheck lists the folders a read job of R245 may open a test copy in, the prototype copies of the data book (round DATA-4). siteBuild holds round Z4 (R200 to R219): folder is the round folder outside the repo with snapshot, work, images and logs under it, template the Revit 2024 metric template a newSite job starts from, newFile the name of the new site file in work, null between rounds so a job that needs it refuses, zoneNbh the neighbourhood of the zone the round is for, answerKey the past site model under inputRoot with the other discipline models listed for inventory only and the code of its Revit 2024 test copy, lock the one window lock both sessions share, waitMinutes how long to wait before the next look, staleHours when a lock with no window process is old enough to delete, minFreeGB the free memory floor before a window, windowProcesses the processes that count as an open window, snapshot the data book files read in this round, roadSurfaces the LandXML exports of the snapshot asked in this order for the plot front level and snapM the edge snap of R157, as roadSurfaceOrder of the data book, coordinateStepM the step the internal origin is rounded to, parameterGroup the group of the new shared parameters, steepUnits the units whose ramp is Ramps 2% and whose El @ Entry takes the steep slope, rampDepthM the Rev 6 ramp depth by unit, bandsMm the compare bands, and key14 the floor parameters of the 1.4 past model that hold its design FFL and El @ Entry (R221), corner the most a road edge midpoint lies from a curb and how near the ramp outline must lie to a face edge to sit on it (R224), footprint the height over the lowest floor level of a prototype that counts as its ground, the overlap a flipped house must gain to flag the mirror and the slack a judged link may lie past the key (R227 to R229), and placeSettleMinutes how long free memory may take to come back over minFreeGB before no more prototype code is placed (R231). placerCheck holds the split check of R261 to R263: position and level each with bandsMm and passMm, the X and Y gap of a link to the key and the gap of the link Z to the key FFL, and dialects names how a key is read, plot by parameter or by the instance Name, datum none or the survey elevation, and floorTypes when its floors are of other types than floors.types. majority holds the share a rule must reach on the past plots to be strong (Round 17) pastAll names what python/past_all.py writes per plot of a past key (R269): linkParameters the link parameters, floorParameters those of the Generic floor of a Native key, and entryParameter the one of them that holds El @ Entry majority holds the majority rule of Round 17 (R270 to R276): strongShare the share a rule must reach to be strong, levelHoldMm how near a level must be to hold, entryRampM how far an El @ Entry parameter may sit off its own ramp top, groups the keys of each generation, codeFrom whether a group is read by its Rev 9 code or its own unit, slopeBands, depthBands and heightBands the bands of the factors, rampTypeClass the slope class each ramp type names, groupSlopes the slope each group is tested with for El @ Entry, sideShare the share of the plot depth two faces must share to be side neighbours, wholeFaceShare the overlap a Generic floor needs to be the whole face, parameterTests the link parameters tested, overrideDecisions the decisions whose misses go to config/overrides/roshn-makkah.json
